sections.title: 1. Strict Zero-Log Commitment
sections.content: FadVPN strictly operates under a verified zero-logs protocol. We do not inspect, log, store, or monitor your online activity, websites visited, search queries, IP addresses, or transmitted payload data.

sections.title: 2. High-Grade Data Encryption
sections.content: All data traveling between your device and global secure gateways is encapsulated using industry-standard cryptographic tunneling protocols. Encryption keys are generated dynamically in volatile device memory and purged immediately upon disconnection.

sections.title: 3. On-Device Traffic Filtering
sections.content: App Protection and firewall preferences operate strictly on your local device environment. Routing selections never transmit application inventories or user diagnostics to external servers.

sections.title: 4. Telemetry & Anonymous Diagnostics
sections.content: When submitting voluntary bug reports or support tickets, only minimal non-identifying telemetry (such as OS version and app release) is collected solely to enhance connection reliability.

sections.title: 5. Legal Disclosures & Transparency
sections.content: Because we maintain zero traffic logs and zero connection records, we possess no identifiable user history to disclose to third parties, regulatory bodies, or external authorities.
